concerns.text: FR-001 (download FluView), FR-006 (download ground truth), and FR-006 (evaluate metrics) lack executable tasks. T012a, T012b, and T016 are marked 'FAILED: unspecified' and contain no implementation logic, leaving the core data ingestion and evaluation requirements unaddressed.

Plan.md and Constitution Principle VII require schema validation (contracts/config.schema.yaml, contracts/dataset.schema.yaml). Tasks T005 and T006 are marked 'FAILED' or incomplete, meaning the system cannot validate configuration or data integrity as required by the spec.

FR-005 (output baselines), FR-007/FR-010 (sensitivity analysis), and SC-004/SC-005 (reporting) lack completed tasks. T025 (baselines.csv), T032 (sensitivity.csv), and T033 (report update) are incomplete, preventing the verification of baseline comparison and robustness success criteria.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires artifact checksums. Task T039 is incomplete, and since the source data artifacts (fluview_ili.csv, ground_truth_events.csv) are missing due to failed download tasks, the versioning discipline cannot be satisfied.
FR-008 mandates automatic permutation reduction if runtime exceeds 30 minutes. Task T014 describes the logic but is marked 'FAILED', meaning the hard time constraint mechanism is not implemented.

Multiple tasks (T011, T012a, T012b, T016) contain the comment 'FAILED: unspecified'. This is a stale status marker from a previous iteration that must be removed or replaced with a valid task description to avoid confusion in the current task list.
